en.headline: HZMB fresh food imports go 24 hours from Thursday
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said vehicles carrying designated fresh produce via the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge may enter at any hour from midnight.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Wednesday that from 12.00am on Thursday, 1 October, operating hours for fresh produce imported via the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge will be extended to 24 hours a day.

A spokesman said the change is meant to give the trade more flexibility in scheduling arrivals and to better match the working patterns of different food sectors. Vehicles bringing designated categories of fresh food from the Mainland by land — frozen and chilled poultry, meat and game, eggs, milk, fresh aquatic products, vegetables and fruit — will then be able to enter Hong Kong via the bridge at any time.

The centre said it will continue to inspect vehicles at the Hong Kong Port of the bridge, checking import documents, carrying out physical inspections and taking samples for testing. Hours and arrangements at the Man Kam To Boundary Control Point remain unchanged, from 7am to 10pm.

Gongbei Customs separately said the all-day window follows earlier expansions of the bridge route, which first opened to a full range of Mainland fresh food for Hong Kong in July 2023 and later lengthened daily hours from eight to 16.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋鮮活食品周四起全日通關
zh.dek: 食安中心表示，十月一日零時起經港珠澳大橋進口指定鮮活食品可全日24小時入境，文錦渡維持朝七晚十。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心星期三表示，由星期四（十月一日）凌晨零時起，經港珠澳大橋進口鮮活食品的通關時間將延長至全日24小時，讓業界更靈活安排抵港時間，配合不同食物行業的運作。
發言人指，從內地經陸路運送指定鮮活食品類別的車輛，包括冷藏和冰鮮家禽、肉類及野味、蛋類、奶類、鮮活水產、蔬菜和水果，屆時可於任何時段經大橋進入本港。
為保障食物安全，食安中心會繼續在港珠澳大橋香港口岸檢查有關車輛，核對進口文件、進行實物檢查並抽取樣本化驗。經文錦渡口岸進口鮮活食品的通關時間及安排維持不變，即每天上午七時至晚上十時。
拱北海關同日表示，全日通關是在2023年7月大橋口岸開放全品類內地鮮活食品供港、其後通關時段由8小時延長至16小時的基礎上再作擴展。
